segmentos.narracion_en: Every Sunday, thousands of families in Cali head to the Pance river. It's a tradition: a pot of sancocho over a wood fire, kids in the water, the whole family together. But the Pance is a mountain river. Heavy rain upstream can make it rise within hours, even when the sky above you looks fine.
segmentos.subtitulo_en: Every Sunday, thousands of families in Cali head to the Pance river. It is a tradition: a pot of sancocho over a wood fire, kids in the water, the whole family enjoying time together. But Pance is a river in the mountains. Heavy rain upstream can make it rise within hours, even when the sky above you looks nice.
segmentos.narracion_es: Cada domingo, miles de familias de Cali van al río Pance. Es una tradición: una olla de sancocho en fogón de leña, los niños en el agua, toda la familia disfrutando junta. Pero el Pance es un río de montaña. Un aguacero río arriba puede hacerlo crecer en pocas horas, aunque el cielo sobre ti se vea bonito.

segmentos.narracion_en: Meet Laura, a fictional character. It's October first, and her family wants to go to the Pance river tomorrow. The app gives her a fifteen percent chance of twenty millimeters or more, well above the nine percent seasonal normal. The basin already got ninety-three point seven millimeters in three days, more than on ninety-eight percent of days. Our code checks every number: it is an elevated risk to go tomorrow.

segmentos.narracion_en: Laura makes a decision: her family stays at home. The next day, a neighbor sees the river rising and reports it. Muse Spark turns the informal message into structured claims, and a second Muse call judges the report against rain gauges, the river level, up sixty-eight centimeters, and NASA satellite rainfall. Confidence is computed by code, not by the model. The report is consistent with the data.
segmentos.subtitulo_en: Laura makes a decision: her family stays at home. The next day, a neighbor sees the river rising and reports it. Confidence is computed by code, not by the model. The report is consistent with the data.
segmentos.narracion_es: Laura toma una decisión: su familia se queda en casa. Al día siguiente, un vecino ve que el río crece y lo reporta. Muse Spark convierte el mensaje informal en afirmaciones estructuradas, y una segunda llamada a Muse juzga el reporte contra los pluviómetros, el nivel del río, que subió 68 centímetros, y la lluvia satelital de la NASA. La confianza la calcula el código, no el modelo. El reporte coincide con los datos.

segmentos.narracion_en: What if someone exaggerates? 'The river rose five meters.' The data doesn't support it, so the report goes to a human reviewer, and it's never published. A false report is flagged as not consistent. Nothing reaches the public map without evidence.
